## Install

1. Download **PS3-Center.dmg** below, open it and drag **PS3 Center** to **Applications**.
2. Open PS3 Center. The first time, macOS stops it because it isn't notarized by Apple: click
   **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**
   next to PS3 Center, then confirm. (On macOS 14 you can instead Control-click the app, choose
   **Open** and confirm.)
3. When macOS asks, **allow** PS3 Center to find devices on your local network. That is how it
   reaches the PS3.

Needs macOS 14 Sonoma or newer, on Apple silicon or Intel, and a PS3 with PS3HEN (or CFW) and
webMAN MOD. The setup guide in the app finds the PS3 on your network.

**ps3-cli.zip** is the optional `ps3` command for Terminal; the README says how to install it.
**SHA256SUMS.txt** has the checksums of both files.

PS3 Center {{VERSION}} is free software under the GPL-3.0. It is not affiliated with Sony.
